spans.s:
A word ending with the Locative -7th-case-affix is compounded with the words सिद्ध 'perfected', शुष्क 'dried', पक्व 'cooked', and बन्ध 'bound' and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष । 

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष

The affix अण् comes after those verbs that have an indicatory षि and after भिद् when the word to be formed is feminine.

Terms: अण्

The affix ङीष् is used in forming the feminine after the words ending with affixes which have an indicatory ष् and after the words गौर etc.

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीष्
